item.title: Get in quick for your chance to win a new Kenworth T909 or K220
item.description: One lucky winner will get to choose between these two trucks. Image: Hepburn Football and Netball Club With sales capped to just 1200 raffle tickets, this competition gives those who take a punt a 1 in 1200 chance of taking home a brand new Kenworth – their choice of a T909 or K220. The competition is being run by the Hepburn Football and Netball Club in Victoria – and it’s the sixth time they’ve raffled off a Kenworth. item.title: Hendrickson appoints new Oceania GM
item.description: Luke Callaway has been appointed General Manager - Oceania at Hendrickson. Image: Hendrickson Hendrickson has appointed Luke Callaway as its new General Manager, heading up the brand’s Oceania operations. Luke has extensive experience with Hendrickson, having worked with the business for over 12 years, in roles covering engineering, sales, and more. item.title: Upcoming traffic disruptions for Gwydir Highway upgrades
item.description: The upgrades will take place about 53 kilometres west of Moree. Image: Transport for NSW There will be changed traffic conditions for a 5.2 kilometre stretch of the Gwydir Highway next week for widening and rehabilitation works. These upgrades will take place about 53 kilometres west of Moree. This is the second stage of a program of upgrades that started last year with road widening, pavement improvements and culvert repairs at Browns Creek. item.title: SES sounds alarm as national freight route cut by floodwaters
item.description: The SES has performed two rescues in 24 hours near Wilcannia. Image: SES The Barrier Highway, a major freight route connecting far west New South Wales to Dubbo and Sydney, has been closed in all directions by floodwaters – and is expected to stay that way for some time. The Central Darling Shire Council said the highway could be closed for more than a week following record-breaking rainfall throughout the region. item.description: The upgrades provide safer access on and off Great Northern Highway, particularly for oversize and over mass vehicles.
